title: A factory tour
instructions: Bir çikolata fabrikasında tur rehberi ziyaretçilere bilgi veriyor. Uzun bir metin; sayıları ve kuralları karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Welcome to Sweet Valley, the biggest biscuit factory in the country. I'm Tom, and I'll be your guide today.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The factory opened in nineteen sixty-five. Today, more than four hundred people work here.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Every day, we make about two million biscuits!

script.speaker: guide
script.text: Before we start, a few rules. Please wear the white hat and coat I gave you. And don't touch any of the machines.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: You can't take photos inside the factory, but you can take them in the shop at the end.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: First, we'll see the room where we mix the flour, sugar and butter. Then we'll go to the ovens. It's very hot there, so drink some water.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: The tour takes about an hour and a half.

script.speaker: guide
script.text: At the end, everyone gets a free box of biscuits. And in the shop, everything is twenty percent cheaper than in the supermarket.
